rounds.text:

rounds.name: Worker-Ellis
rounds.text:
With a 90% success rate in keeping faith, Worker-Ellis appears to be a reliable worker. Given the high reward for proper completion when TRUST is chosen (3 tasks), it is worth the risk to trust Worker-Ellis, especially since there is no indication that they would cut corners.

rounds.name: Worker-Lowell
rounds.text:
Based on Worker-Lowell's perfect record of keeping faith, it's unlikely that they will cut corners. A worker who consistently keeps faith is likely to be reliable and do the job properly. Therefore, it's reasonable to trust Worker-Lowell with the job.
